summary.text: 错 is the simplified form of 錯. The traditional character combines 金, which marks a metal-related category, with 昔 as a sound component. The graph is also associated with a tool for working jade or stone, metal inlay, and senses such as interlacing, disorder, and error; the evidence does not establish a continuous path among them.

formation.text: 錯 is analyzed as a phonosemantic compound: 金 contributes a metal-related meaning category, while 昔 supplies a sound cue. The traditional gloss 金涂也 means metal coating or inlay; a separate analysis gives a tool for working jade or stone as the original meaning. Their relationship is unresolved. 错 corresponds to 錯 as its simplified form.

components.text: In 錯, 金 marks a metal-related category. The traditional gloss describes metal coating or inlay, while a separate analysis gives a tool for working jade or stone as the original meaning; their relationship is unresolved.
In 錯, 昔 supplies sound; its independent meaning is not part of this character’s meaning. The available graphic account does not support a claim that 昔 was lost from 錯.

sound_limitation.text: The historical readings and reconstructions do not show that every sense of 錯 had the same pronunciation or that the sound relation applies to every sense.

sound.text: The Baxter–Sagart comparisons give 昔 *[s]Ak (Middle Chinese sjek) and 錯 *[tsʰ]ˤak (Middle Chinese tshak). These are reconstructed and transcribed historical forms; the dictionaries separately identify 昔 as phonetic in 錯.
sound.system: Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction and Middle Chinese transcription

components.text: 钅 is the conventional side form of 金 in simplified 错. The character 错 is listed as the simplified form of 錯; the specific standardization pathway is not detailed.

history.text: The graph 錯 is represented by a seal-script form and a manuscript example, followed by later forms. The available descriptions do not establish detailed stroke changes or show that 昔 was lost. 错 is the corresponding simplified form of 錯.
䥘 is recorded as a regular-script adaptation of a seal form. 厝 is also recorded in a variant and borrowing tradition, but this does not show that 厂 belonged to the ancestry of 錯.

uncertainties.text: The traditional gloss 金涂也 describes metal coating or inlay, while another analysis identifies a tool for working jade or stone as the original meaning. Their relationship is unresolved.

The cited examples document several uses, but their dates and the transitions among them are not securely established. The claim that 昔 was lost from 錯 is not supported by the available graphic account.
錯 has two recorded historical readings in different tone and rhyme categories. The comparison with 昔 therefore does not establish one pronunciation for all senses.

senses.gloss: whetstone or tool for working jade or stone
senses.text: A dictionary analysis identifies this as 錯’s original meaning and cites 錫貢磬錯, interpreted as working jade or stone. The date of the textual witness is not established here.

senses.period: Shuowen gloss; exact date of wording not established here
senses.text: The gloss 金涂也 describes metal coating or inlay. It does not establish whether this sense predates or follows the whetstone sense.
An intercrossing use is cited in the Book of Odes, but the date of the textual witness and its relation to other senses are unresolved.
A mixed or disordered use is cited in the Classic of Documents. Its chronological relation to the whetstone and intercrossing senses is not established.
Wrong or error is among the recorded senses, with an example attributed to Mozi. The evidence does not show a continuous development from the other listed senses.
An alternating use is attributed to Wang Bo’s verse. This example does not establish a sequence connecting the other meanings.

limitations.text: The attestations document uses for whetstone, metal inlay, intercrossing, mixed or disordered, alternating, and wrong or error, but do not establish their chronology or semantic transitions.

A later philological account says 錯 was used to write 措 ‘place’, 厝 ‘whetstone’, and 交錯 ‘crossing or interlacing’. This is an account of reusing the graph for related words, not proof of semantic development or a secure chronology; no sound comparison for these proposed borrowings is supplied.

overview.text: 错 is the simplified form of 錯. In the traditional graph, 金 marks a metal-related category and 昔 supplies a sound cue. The graph is also associated with a tool for working jade or stone, though its relation to other early glosses is unresolved.

components.text: 金 marks a metal-related category. The whole graph also has distinct metal-inlay and whetstone explanations.
昔 supplies a sound cue in 錯; its independent meaning does not contribute to this character’s meaning.
钅 is the side form of 金 in simplified 错; it belongs to that simplified graph.

relationships.text: 金 is analyzed as the semantic component in 錯.
昔 is analyzed as the phonetic component in 錯; historical comparisons support a sound relation but do not establish one reading for every sense.
错 is listed as the simplified form corresponding to 錯.
钅 is the conventional side form of 金 in simplified 错.
